通知提醒框的常规使用方式是通过回调向某个容器输出，每一次输出都会触发一条新的通知.en-us: Return a notification component into a container from a callback. Each output adds a new notification.

通过参数`type`控制通知提醒框的类型。.en-us: Use `type` to choose the notification type.

通过参数`duration`控制通知提醒框的显示时长。.en-us: Use `duration` to set how long a notification is displayed.

设置参数`showProgress=True`显示关闭进度条。.en-us: Set `showProgress=True` to display automatic close progress.
